description: Deep-compare two JSON documents: see added, removed and changed values with JSON paths, color-coded and counted.

faqs.a: Objects are compared key by key, arrays element by element (by index), and every difference is reported with its JSON path like $.user.address.city.
Arrays compare by index: a changed element at index 2 is reported as changed at $[2], not as remove+add.
Yes — the diff updates live as you type, with per-side syntax error messages.
Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Paste the original JSON on the left and the modified JSON on the right.
Differences appear live, grouped as added, removed or changed.
Click Copy report for a plain-text summary of every difference.
title: JSON Diff Checker
